svg.title: How Panter-ai fits together
svg.desc: Diagram. Left: AI hosts (Claude, GPT-A, GPT-B, Grok and Gemini) connect to Panter-ai over MCP with OAuth; one of them is the leader set by PANTER_LEAD_HOST and the others are workers. Center: Panter-ai with its automatic harness, review gate, mesh and workforce, GitHub workforce, Engram memory and per-role tool surface. Right: downstream MCP servers, each in its own repository and service, reached through Panter's gateway. Bottom: GitHub, where pull requests, CI and an independent reviewer account gate every merge.
